task: Owner smoke of the death-frame deferral candidate (XEX b8ed318c…) FAILED: on every death, two PlayerFighter images appear during respawn — one centred, one offset left — flicker briefly and then resolve to one ship. Diagnose, then fix without re-planning Option E.

regression.introduced_by: ac67d9e (Option E, death-frame deferral). NOT pre-existing: 2a8ff26 has no begin call in the DYING path at all, and the same reproduction there ends the respawn frame with FIGHTER_EXPLOSION_TIMER 0, one published image and HPOSP0/P3 at PLAYER_RESPAWN_X.
regression.root_cause: player_dying_tick guarded the deferred begin with FIGHTER_EXPLOSION_TIMER[player] == 0, read as 'begin pending'. On the LAST DYING frame that test is wrong: tick_shared_fighter_explosions (main_loop, before integration_update_player_death) erases the player slot at timer 1 and decrements it to 0 earlier in the same frame. player_dying_tick then read 0, called begin_player_fighter_explosion at the still-pre-death player_x/player_y, and fell through two instructions later to respawn_player.
regression.why_that_frame: BROAD_DEATH_TIMER = SHARED_FIGHTER_EXPLOSION_TOTAL+1 makes the death timer and the explosion timer finish on the same frame — the single frame on which an idle slot means 'just finished' rather than 'not yet begun'.

measured_symptom.harness: tests/entity-effects.test.mjs runtime image, lethal Interceptor contact at player_x 124 / player_y 100, PMG RAM zeroed first, driven in main_loop order tick_shared_fighter_explosions -> update_player_death -> render_shared_fighter_explosions.

frame_N_plus_25.update_player_death: begin_player_fighter_explosion x1 (timer 0 -> 24, origin 120/104) then respawn_player: PLAYER0 -> 225-239, PLAYER3 -> 229-239, HPOSP0/P3 120 -> 124
frame_N_plus_25.render_shared_fighter_explosions: phase 0 republished at rows 107-108 in both planes; HPOSP0/P3 124 -> 120
frame_N_plus_25.result: two published images for a further 24 frames (N+25..N+48), 4 colour clocks apart; HPOSP0/P3 end the frame at the explosion X, not PLAYER_RESPAWN_X

measured_symptom.ordering_was_correct: The intended erase-before-respawn ordering held throughout: tick_shared_fighter_explosions at +0 cycles (cost 305), update_player_death at +305 (cost 1,892), render_shared_fighter_explosions at +2,197 (cost 487). The defect was the re-begin inside update_player_death, after the erase.

fix.shape: Option (a): the finishing frame leaves before the idle-slot test. player_dying_tick decrements BROAD_DEATH_TIMER first and branches to update_player_death_finished on zero; only a non-finishing DYING frame reaches the idle-slot test and the deferred begin.
fix.why_provably_correct: apply_player_damage (lethal tail) is the only writer of PLAYER_LIFECYCLE = PLAYER_DYING and the only writer of BROAD_DEATH_TIMER other than respawn_player's zero, and it sets both in one unbranched straight-line tail. DYING is therefore always entered with BROAD_DEATH_TIMER = SHARED_FIGHTER_EXPLOSION_TOTAL+1, so 'not the finishing frame' is exactly 'the explosion has not been begun yet, or is still running'. No begin-pending flag (option b) is needed.
fix.deferral_unchanged: BROAD_DEATH_TIMER stays SHARED_FIGHTER_EXPLOSION_TOTAL+1; the death frame still pays neither erase_player nor the first explosion phase; DYING still lasts 25 frames; the explosion still self-erases in the respawn frame, before respawn_player.

placement.entity_code: unchanged; player_dying_tick still 18 B at the ENTITY_CODE tail (the light-wingman placement freeze holds)
placement.lbl_diff: one line: the cheap local .@tick $9D3E becomes .@running $9D43. No global label moved, no segment size changed.

pal_timing_audit.procedure: Full gate set as stage-2b2q/2b2r: default run (aborts at the pre-existing weapon-pickup-contact invariant after 21 sessions), every later default session with --skip-boot-smoke --only-session, --debris-gate-only, --raider-remnant-only; then scripts/pal-timing-audit.mjs over all CSVs.

focused_tests.note: failure-name set identical to a build of ac67d9e in a scratch worktree (173 tests / 17 failing); the two added tests both pass

test_coverage.why_the_old_test_missed_it: The ac67d9e deferral test read the explosion timer only BEFORE the final update_player_death, never called render_shared_fighter_explosions, and asserted nothing about PLAYER0/PLAYER3, HPOSP0/HPOSP3 or COLBK. It is a timer/lifecycle test and cannot see a second published image.
added: entity-effects: 'the deferred death sequence publishes exactly one PlayerFighter image from the respawn frame on' — drives tick_shared_fighter_explosions -> update_player_death -> render_shared_fighter_explosions -> update_sound for frames N+1..N+50 and asserts: explosion timer 0 after the final update_player_death; exactly one contiguous published image in PLAYER0 and PLAYER3, equal to what draw_player publishes at the respawn origin; HPOSP0/HPOSP3 = PLAYER_RESPAWN_X at the end of the respawn frame and every frame after it; COLBK = GAMEPLAY_BACKGROUND_COLOR throughout the respawn (no death-flash replay); the finished explosion record left unrestarted at the pre-death origin.

entity-effects: 'the deferred begin still fires when the player dies at the respawn row' — the same sequence with the death origin overlapping the respawn rows, where the restarted explosion used to overwrite and later erase the live ship's own PMG bytes.
game-over: the player_dying_tick source freeze rebaselined to the corrected instruction order, with the reason in the file.
